primary.description: Body copy, treatment descriptions, headings, form labels — the default reading colour. 14.78:1 on surface/page, 15.45:1 on surface/card.

secondary.description: Documentation-page labels and table headers on the Foundations pages (Colors, Spacing, Typography). Not yet used on any live product component — "card subtitles, treatment duration, breadcrumbs" describes planned future use, not current. Breadcrumb uses text/link, not this token. 6.57:1 on surface/page, 6.86:1 on surface/card.

tertiary.description: Helper text under form inputs, footnotes, supporting detail inside cards. 4.60:1 on surface/page, 4.81:1 on surface/card — passes AA body. Shares its value with text/placeholder today (both alias neutral/600); kept as separate tokens since they mean different things even when they render the same.

disabled.description: Disabled button labels, unavailable appointment slot text, locked form step labels. 2.54:1 on surface/disabled — intentional WCAG 1.4.3 exemption. Always pair with a non-colour cue.

inverse.description: Body copy in the Footer — brand blurb, nav link columns, Practice details, contact info. "Dark longevity sections" is planned, not yet built. 17.88:1 on surface/inverse (neutral/50, warm off-white — matches the reduced-glare logic of surface/page, just inverted).

link.description: Breadcrumb items, Plain-variant button labels, card "Explore →" affordances, and inline links within body paragraphs. 6.02:1 on surface/page, 6.29:1 on surface/card. Underlined only when used inline within body copy, where colour alone isn't a sufficient cue against surrounding text. Breadcrumbs, buttons, and card affordances read as interactive via their component context (position, icon, being a button) and don't carry an underline.

link-hover.description: Hover and focus state on inline links. 8.82:1 on surface/page.

link-inverse.description: Not currently used in any built component. Use case undecided.

brand.description: Overline eyebrow labels above section titles (not the headings themselves), Badge label colour (Type=brand), Secondary button label, and the active-state Nav Link label — pairs with surface/brand's active indicator. 6.02:1 on surface/page.

accent.description: Earth-coloured editorial headings, pull quotes, treatment category labels. 8.45:1 on surface/page.

on-fill.description: Text and icons on any dark filled surface — primary button labels on surface/action, headings on surface/brand, copy on surface/accent editorial blocks. 6.29:1 on surface/action and surface/brand (ocean/700), 8.83:1 on surface/accent (earth/700). Replaces the former text/on-brand and text/on-accent, which were the same white doing the same job.

success.description: Confirmation copy — "Your request is in, we’ll call within one business day." 8.01:1 on surface/success. Also the label colour of the success Badge.

warning.description: Advisory copy — out-of-state travel notes, limited availability messages. 7.81:1 on surface/warning. Also the label colour of the warning Badge.

error.description: Validation messages beside the failing field. Supportive tone, never blaming. 8.89:1 on surface/error. Also the label colour of the error Badge.

info.description: Explanatory copy — cash-pay policy, what to bring, telehealth eligibility. 8.94:1 on surface/info. Also the label colour of the info Badge.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text inside empty form fields — "you@example.com", "Search conditions". 4.81:1 on surface/input. Currently aliases the same primitive as text/tertiary (neutral/600) — kept as a separate token because placeholder and helper text are different semantic roles (empty-state hint vs. supporting content) even though they render identically today. A lighter placeholder-specific value was considered but neutral/500 only clears 2.81:1 on surface/input, below the 3:1 floor — not worth the contrast trade-off for visual distinction alone.

background.description: Base page canvas behind all content on every route. Warm off-white rather than pure white to reduce glare for light-sensitive readers.

card.description: Treatment and condition cards, practitioner bio panels, FAQ accordions. Lifts off the page without needing a border.

input.description: Text fields, selects, textareas, date pickers in the booking and intake forms. Always pair with border/strong.

inverse.description: Not currently used in any built component. Use case undecided.

disabled.description: Disabled buttons, unavailable appointment slots, locked form steps.

brand.description: Active/selected-state indicator on Nav Link (the underline bar) — Navigation, Dropdown menu, Footer nav links. Aliases ocean/700 in Clinic, flora/300 in Supplement — same primitive as surface/action, text/link, text/brand, border/focus.

brand-subtle.description: Badge background (Type=brand), Feature Card icon-frame background.

accent.description: Not currently used in any built component. Aliases earth/700 — reserved for future editorial/feature-panel use.

accent-subtle.description: Badge background (Type=accent), Feature Card label chip background.

action.description: Primary buttons — "Book an appointment", "Start intake". NOT ocean/600: white on 600 measures 4.44:1 and fails body text. In Supplement mode aliases flora/300 — primary CTA colour for the supplement line.

action-hover.description: Hover state on primary buttons. White label reads 9.22:1.

action-pressed.description: Active and pressed state on primary buttons.

success.description: Booking confirmed panels, "request received" states, saved-intake banners. Also the background colour of the success Badge.

warning.description: Out-of-state logistics notices, "call to confirm availability" strips. Also the background colour of the warning Badge.

error.description: Form validation summaries, failed submission banners. Also the background colour of the error Badge.

info.description: Cash-pay policy notes, what-to-bring callouts, first-visit and telehealth explainers. Also the background colour of the info Badge.

overlay.description: Scrim behind modals and the mobile navigation drawer. Raw rgba(20,18,16,0.60) — transparency cannot alias a primitive. Warm-tinted to match neutral/950.

decorative.description: Illustration fills, image mattes, mascot colourways, decorative shapes behind content. The Sand brand value. SHAPE_FILL only — never text or borders (1.61:1 on surface/page).

hover.description: Hover state on nav items, dropdown items, secondary/plain buttons, and text field inputs.

selected.description: Selected state — the chosen condition card, active filter chip, current step in the intake flow. Stronger than surface/brand-subtle so selection reads as a deliberate act rather than a highlight. text/primary reads 12.8:1 here.

subtle.description: Dividers between list items, table row rules, section separators. Decorative at 1.19:1 — exempt from 3:1 because it carries no information. Also used as the outer edge of the Dropdown panel (Simple List, Mega Menu) — a structural boundary rather than a decorative divider, though currently bound to the same subtle value.

default.description: Card outlines, non-interactive container edges, and Text Field's default (resting) border. 1.51:1 on surface/card. Note: on Text Field, this is currently the only visual affordance that the control is interactive until hover/focus changes it — that's in tension with this token's general rule of never being the sole indicator of an interactive control. Flagged, not yet resolved.

strong.description: Text Field's Active-state border, Feature Card's Hover-state border. 4.81:1 on surface/card, clears the 3:1 non-text requirement. Not currently used on checkboxes, radios, or selects — none of those components exist yet.

focus.description: Keyboard focus ring on every interactive element — 2px weight at 2px OFFSET. The offset is load-bearing, not decorative: it lifts the ring off the control so the ring's neighbouring colour is always the page background (6.02:1, passes WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 at 3:1). Flush against a brand-filled surface it drops to 1.0:1 and disappears, because this token and surface/action both alias ocean/700. Implement as outline: 2px solid + outline-offset: 2px. Never removable, never flush.

brand.description: Secondary button outline (all states), Badge border (Type=brand). 4.25:1 on surface/background — clears the 3:1 UI-component threshold. Pair with text/brand for the label. Not currently used for filter chips, tab underlines, or condition-card outlines — none of those components exist yet.

accent.description: Badge border (Type=accent), Feature Card label chip border. Not currently used for pull-quote rules or treatment-card dividers — no such component exists yet.

success.description: Badge border (Type=success). Not currently used as a confirmation-panel left rule — no such component exists yet.

warning.description: Badge border (Type=warning). Not currently used as an advisory-panel left rule — no such component exists yet.

error.description: Failed input field outline. 5.03:1 on surface/background. Always paired with an icon and a message.

info.description: Badge border (Type=info). Not currently used as an informational-callout left rule — no such component exists yet.
